task.title: Commission the link
task.shortdesc: Pair the station with the site account and confirm it reports.

context.p: Register the serial number at before the first upload.

step.cmd: Open the commissioning page and enter the site code.
Wait for the first upload, which takes up to ten minutes.

section.title: If the first upload does not arrive
section.p: Restart the station and watch the status LED.

note.p: An upload that keeps failing after a restart is almost always a certificate date problem; read the clock over the service port.
